Prices

Questions

How much do projects in games, AR and VR development cost?
An MVP in this group costs $3,000–70,000 (UZS 36–845 mln), a full version up to $250,000. The exact price depends on the solution, the integrations and the scope.
How long does it take?
An MVP takes 3–20 weeks, a full version 6–52 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Who plays and why; Brand materials; One person who makes the decisions.
